H~π/(2α²) gives p<2 Gaussian-linearized h^(p/2) moments, critical variance S h log(1/h)/(2√detΣ), and p>2 integral moments. Stationary current gives signed mean h uΔ/(2√detΣ); optimizing its squared mean over leading variance reduces to a quadratic in y=u² with one root y∈(1/2,2/3).
